description: The European Tsunami Risk Service publishes empirical tsunami-impact data and derived probabilistic risk products. Its November 2025 GitHub archive and earlier March 2025 Zenodo deposit are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The documented folders contain literature-derived intensity, damage and fatality observations, together with damage scales, fragility functions, consequence relationships, vulnerability curves and loss curves. GED4ALL labels identify exposed-element classes. These inputs can calibrate tsunami damage and loss simulations. Geographic coverage and observation periods follow the underlying events; source completeness, uniformity of units and transferability between building classes remain uncertain. Catalogue record model-etris-simulation-based-ptra-building is a related simulation tool, not this empirical collection. Individual source citations must be retained when reusing the data. Only the repository README and metadata were read; tables were not downloaded or calculations reproduced.
